integrity: The analytical proof establishes all-even-side-count formulas and equality limits; independent finite-geometry calculations are corroborative and not an all-parameter certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical real radial retraction on the unit ball of an even regular polygon or an invertible linear image is treated; the minimum over arbitrary retractions, nonregular polygons and higher-dimensional Banach balls is not determined. Classical Radon nonexpansivity and prior regular-octagon values are explicitly credited. Historic 1967 and 1974 original full texts were unavailable; absolute bibliographic priority is not asserted.
title: Sharp radial-retraction constants and vertex-localized amplification for regular even polygons
